reasoning: This is the mathematical 'congruent to' / 'approximately equal to' symbol (≅) drawn with a sharp angular tilde over an equals sign. It is an abstract math operator that almost never serves as the concrete subject of a to-do item, and at small sizes it is easily confused with a tiny line chart over two lines of text or a menu icon.
